environment.description: Terraform Cloud workspace running provider against OpenLDAP 2.4.57 on Ubuntu 20.04. Provider binary executed with standard Terraform Cloud agent. LDAP bind credentials stored as Terraform Cloud workspace variables (marked sensitive). Network allows direct LDAPS (port 636) from agent to LDAP server. No input validation middleware. Terraform plan/apply triggered via VCS webhook from GitHub repository where contributors can modify .tf files including resource arguments.

config.runtime: Terraform Cloud Business, agent pool v1.7
config.ldap_server: OpenLDAP 2.4.57, no query restrictions, anonymous read enabled on subtree
config.network: Direct LDAPS connectivity, no proxy or inspection
config.auth: Simple bind with cn=admin,dc=corp,dc=example,dc=com (full directory admin)
config.input_source: GitHub PR contributors can set group_name and username in .tf files
